models_evaluated: Commercial CE-marked (MDR class IIa) deep learning DWI ischemic lesion detection software, version 1.0

links.outcome: Lesion-level and patient-level sensitivity of commercial AI on local retrospective DWI data versus expert neurologist reference standard
links.effect: Lesion-level sensitivity 83.51% (95% CI 79.8-86.8%); patient-level sensitivity 95.31% (95% CI 91.8-97.6%); undetected lesions were smaller, covered fewer slices, and had higher ADC values.
links.quote: The software achieved a lesion-level sensitivity of 83.51% (95% CI, 79.8-86.8%) and a patient-level sensitivity of 95.31% (95% CI, 91.8-97.6%).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a commercially available CE-marked AI software for ischemic lesion detection on DWI without evaluating a specific operational deployment practice or guardrail.
